title: Throne-Echo Medium
text: Throne-Echo Medium channels a dead audience whose applause drowns out every useful signal. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The hall is gone, but the spectators refuse to leave.

defeatReward.text: Throne-Echo Medium is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
